title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 2: Hannah's song, the sins of Eli's sons, young Samuel, and the man of God's warning.

questions.text: In her prayer, what did Hannah say is exalted in Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Hannah prayed, "My heart exults in Yahweh! My horn is exalted in Yahweh."

questions.text: Complete Hannah's words: "Nor is there any ... like our God."
questions.explanation: Hannah said, "There is no one as holy as Yahweh ... nor is there any rock like our God."

questions.text: What does Hannah's song say about the barren woman?
questions.explanation: Hannah sang, "Yes, the barren has borne seven. She who has many children languishes."

questions.text: What did the priest's servant hold in his hand while the meat was boiling?
questions.explanation: The priest's servant came while the meat was boiling, with a fork of three teeth in his hand.

questions.text: What did the priest's servant say the priest would not accept?
questions.explanation: The servant said, "He will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw."

questions.text: What did Samuel's mother bring him from year to year?
questions.explanation: His mother made him a little robe and brought it to him from year to year when she came up with her husband.

answers.text: A little robe she had made

questions.text: What children did Hannah bear after Yahweh visited her?
questions.explanation: Yahweh visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters.

questions.text: Why did Eli's sons not listen to their father?
questions.explanation: They didn't listen to the voice of their father, because Yahweh intended to kill them.

answers.text: Eli spoke to them too softly

questions.text: How did the child Samuel grow?
questions.explanation: The child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with Yahweh and also with men.

answers.text: In strength but not in wisdom
In favor with both Yahweh and men

questions.text: What sign did the man of God give Eli about Hophni and Phinehas?
questions.explanation: The man of God said the sign would be that in one day both of Eli's sons would die.

answers.text: They would both die in one day
